LLM-Assisted Analysis

14/15 scenarios passed; scene_object_fixture fails on robot-only output

Provider: deepseek · Model: deepseek-chat · Generated On: 2026-07-05T07:19:03+00:00 · Stage: scenario · Confidence: high

The CI run tested 15 scenarios covering builtin, cap, and flow families. 14 passed; the single failure is `scene_object_fixture`, which calls `robonix/system/scene/list_objects` and expects at least one non-robot object (label != "robot") in the output. The scene service returned only the robot self-object (`scene.object.robot_001`) across all 45 rounds, causing the regex assertion `"label":\s*"(?!robot)[^"]+"` to fail. All other scenarios (camera/lidar snapshots, explore, navigation, memory, speech, voiceprint, mapping, fault recovery, patrol observe, object navigation) passed successfully.

PR Changes

  • system/pilot/src/planner.rs: Added `extract_json_object` to strip prose preamble before JSON parsing in RTDL responses; updated prompt to require JSON-only replies.
  • system/scene/README.md: Documented VLM-primary scene graph, stable object identity knobs, and new env vars.
  • system/scene/scene_service/ingest/perception_concept_graphs.py: Added cross-tick re-bind, soft eviction, same-class proximity collapse, merge class groups, and many tunable env vars for object identity stability.
  • system/scene/scene_service/ingest/perception_vlm.py: Added `VLM_REASONING_EFFORT` env var support.
  • system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/builder.py: VLM-primary image-grounded relation pass; transient-blip guard preserves edges when <2 stable nodes; text fallback for semantic-only inference.
  • system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/geometric_loop.py: New fast geometric loop (~3 Hz) producing `reachable_by` edges with debounce hysteresis.
  • system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/geometry.py: Deterministic geometric predicates (contact/containment) and jitter-stable cache signature.
  • system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/image_relations.py: Image-grounded VLM relation inference: project objects into camera frame, annotate, one VLM call for all relations.
  • system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/llm_client.py: Added multimodal image support and `VLM_REASONING_EFFORT` forwarding.
  • system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/prompts.py: Added semantic-only relation prompt and helper.
  • system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/relations.py: Added `_normalize_relation`, `infer_semantic_relation`, increased LLM timeout to 60s.
  • system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/store.py: Two-writer store (geometric + semantic slices); geometry-signature-based cache invalidation; `prune_relations`.
  • system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/types.py: Added `reachable_by` to RELATION_TYPES; added `geometric` method.
  • system/scene/scene_service/service.py: Wired geometric loop and scene graph store unconditionally; LLM enrichment gated by SCENE_GRAPH_ENABLED.
  • system/scene/scene_service/state/__init__.py: Removed RelationEngine exports.
  • system/scene/scene_service/state/object_registry.py: Added `find_rebindable`, `soft_evict`, `prune_expired` for cross-tick object identity.
  • system/scene/scene_service/state/relations.py: Removed (replaced by geometric loop + scene graph).
  • system/scene/scene_service/web.py: Updated to use scene graph store; relations shown as text list instead of on-canvas lines.
  • system/scene/scripts/start.sh: Added env var passthrough for new scene knobs.
  • system/scene/tests/test_identity.py: New unit tests for object identity stability.
  • system/scene/tests/test_image_relations.py: New unit tests for image-grounded relation pass.
  • system/scene/tests/test_persistence.py: Added missing attributes to detector stub.
  • system/scene/tests/test_scene_graph.py: Updated tests for new store API, geometric relations, cache invalidation, debounce, semantic inference, normalization, reasoning effort, prune_relations.

Test Result

  • Webots CI exercised 15 scenarios: 4 builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, plan_control_builtins, run_command), 7 cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), and 3 flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe). 14 passed. The failing scenario `scene_object_fixture` called `list_objects` 45 times; each time the scene service returned only the robot self-object, so the test's regex assertion for a non-robot label failed.

Likely Root Cause

  • The scene service's perception pipeline (concept-graphs detector) did not detect any non-robot objects during the test window. The registry contained only the robot self-object (`scene.object.robot_001`). This is likely because the Webots simulation world used in CI has no furniture or objects placed in the robot's field of view, or the perception models (YOLO-World, MobileSAM) did not fire within the test duration.

Suggested Fix

  • Ensure the Webots CI world includes at least one non-robot object (e.g., a table, chair, or box) within the robot's initial field of view so the perception pipeline has something to detect. Alternatively, adjust the test to accept a robot-only scene as valid (e.g., relax the regex or add a separate test for empty scenes). The pymilvus import error is a pre-existing environment issue and does not affect this test.

Risks Or Watchouts

  • The scene_object_fixture test will continue to fail in CI unless the simulation world is populated with objects.
  • The pymilvus import error prevents object memory persistence, but does not affect the current test failure.
  • Other scenarios (explore, navigation) rely on the robot being able to move and detect objects; they passed, indicating the robot can navigate but no objects were detected.
